- TOTAL revenue reached £32.9k in TW, up 65.6% WoW from £19.9k in LW and up 245.6% YoY against £9.5k in LY.
- TOTAL units came in at 11,786 in TW, up 102.5% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 697 in TW, up 12.6% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 in TW with £2,616.00 revenue, holding an 8.0% share of TOTAL TW revenue.
- The top five products accounted for 24.8% of TOTAL TW revenue, led by CHILLI LIGHTS at £1,516.30, HEART OF WICKER SMALL at £1,365.96, JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT at £1,356.16 and PARTY BUNTING at £1,301.83 in TW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS added £1,306.21 WoW and HEART OF WICKER SMALL added £1,024.48 WoW, the two largest absolute gains in TW.
- VINTAGE UNION JACK BUNTING fell £1,483.24 WoW, a decline of 64.8% WoW, the largest absolute drop in TW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER declined £1,480.80 WoW, down 36.1% WoW, despite holding the number 1 rank in TW.
- CHARLOTTE BAG SUKI DESIGN rose 1,286.1% WoW and DOORMAT FAIRY CAKE rose 628.6% WoW in TW.
